{{Spoiler Warning}}

The '''Proving Fields''' were [[Special Mission|Spotlight Mission]] featuring [[:Category:Beast Wars|Beast Wars bots]] that ran from December 19 to 24.

== Synopsis ==

== Changes/Rewards ==

== Transcript ==

=== 1: Optimus Primal Proving Field  ===
Part 1: 

'''[[Marissa Faireborn]]''': ''Commander, some of the Bots want to demonstrate just how strong they are.Seems like one timeline in particular is waiting to show off.''

'''[[Optimus Primal]]''': ''Leadership is difficult Commander, let us work together.''

<nowiki> </nowiki>Part 2:

'''[[Cheetor]]''': ''Sparring match going well?''

'''Optimus Primal''': ''The Commander seems keen to face most challenges.''

'''Cheetor''': ''Well you've messed with the rest, why not try the best?''

'''Optimus Primal''': ''Hah, alright Cheetor. Time to show you the value of experience and patience.''

'''Cheetor''': ''Patience lessons? I can't wait!''

=== 2: Scorponok Proving Field ===

=== 3: Rhinox Proving Field ===
Part 1:

'''[[Rhinox]]''': ''Come with me Commander, I will show you the strength of brains AND brawn.''

Part 2: 

'''Scorponok''': ''What's the idea with the one Bot team? Think you're so great?''

'''Rhinox''': ''This is what I was talking about. Big, evil and stupid is no way to go through life, Scorponok.''

'''Scorponok''': ''Yeah well...takes one to know one!''

'''Rhinox''': ''Witty back and forth, that's what I come to these fights for.''

=== 4: Cheetor Proving Field ===
Part 1:

'''Cheetor''': ''Hey if you're looking for a one-bot party, I'm your party ANIMAL! Let's go have some fun, Commander!''

Part 2:

'''Cheetor''': ''Isn't this just fantastic?''

'''[[Dinobot]]''': ''Battle is not meant as entertainment fur-ball.''

'''Cheetor''': ''I dunno, pretty sure the Commander and I are going to have smiles on our faces as we kick your tail!''

=== 5: Waspinator Proving Field ===

=== 6: Dinobot Proving Field ===
Part 1:

'''Dinobot''': ''The warrior's way is hard fought, I can show you what it takes Commander.''

Part 2:

'''Scorponok''': ''Aw come on, is it pick on Scorponok day?''

'''Dinobot''': ''I require a punching bag to demonstrate my skills. You're as close to non-sentient as I could acquire.''

'''Scorponok''': ''I'll show YOU who's non-scented!''

'''Dinobot''': ''...I'm sure you will. Commander, shall we?''
